what: The official versions of the book Generation Z Developers, oldest first: the versions this repository holds. The working versions live in the public vault and move here when signed off. text_sha256 is the sha256 of the book's frozen markdown as the version was built (the book as published, the front matter and the published chapters in the print edition's order, assembled by admin/build/build.py from v1/content/); the build stops when the assembled text no longer matches the newest entry, so the frozen text cannot change without a version. A change to the text is the next minor version, the last number (v1.0.1 after v1.0.0); the middle number moves only when Dinis says a change is major, and the first for a new edition, when Dinis says so (decision 006). Each version is frozen at v1/versions/<version>.md by the release that made it and never rewritten; the delta between consecutive versions is computed from the frozen files by page_versions.py, block by block and word by word.

versions.where: Amazon paperback (139 pages, published 30 September 2018, ISBN-10 1724194607), Leanpub (60% complete, 136 pages, 30,695 words, last updated 8 October 2018), and DinisCruz/Book_Generation_Z_Developer at 61886444fe5ab118ab18726147826ab05f794edc
versions.by: Dinis Cruz, with content fixes and contributions by Mike Eriksson, Michael Chadwick, Claudio Camerino, Mark Regensberg and Sarah Cruz (the 2018 change log)
versions.why: The first edition as published: the 28 chapters the 2018 build put in the Leanpub book and the print PDF (status: content, parts by weight, chapters by weight then title), with the front-matter page of GitHub issues; imported verbatim from the 2018 repository on 2026-10-18 and frozen. The drafts and outlines the build left out are not part of this version: they are kept beside it (v1/book/drafts.md) as the second edition's raw material. (Site v0.1.0 froze the whole repository, drafts included; v0.2.0 re-froze v1.0.0 as the published book, the day after, before any second version existed.)

candidates_what: Release candidates of the next edition, oldest first: drafts written in this repository under v2/content/ for Dinis to read and mark up (decisions 008 and 009). Not versions: not official, not published outside this site. text_sha256 is filled in once by the build from the candidate's assembled markdown, frozen at v2/versions/<version>.md; a change to the text after that is the next candidate.

candidates.status: Release candidate 1 of the second edition: not signed off, not an official version.
candidates.what: The first end-to-end draft of the second edition, written by the book's agents from the ideas register (106 ideas, 50 of them Dinis's own positions from his co-written articles) and the articles, decisions and 2018 text behind them, in the proposed chapter map's order; the hands-on part, dated 2026, is included so that Dinis can decide whether it stays inside the book or becomes a companion. Where only Dinis can supply something, the chapter says so in a note.

candidates.what: The book rewritten under the Gen ZX frame Dinis chose (decision 014): two generations, the founder as the reader, the objective that by the end the reader has started a company, a new part Start the company at the centre, Building, safely rebuilt as Build it without a server, a new first chapter and four more hands-on chapters, the measure in the last chapter; the round-1 batch of newsroom articles processed into ideas and written in. Where the newsroom has no article yet (the UK company, Lithuania, Portugal, the EU, the first customers, the community), the chapter stands as its title, its ideas and what is missing.
